title: Land In Pootung Beloging To Chinese Eastern Railway-Transfer Of Ownership

page_data.en:
6469
July 4, 1935.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:-

TRANSFER OF THE PROPERTY OF THE C.E.R. IN SHANGHAI

The agreement for the sale of the
Chinese Eastern Railway to Japan having been concluded,
the Japanese Government has authorized the South
Manchurian Railway Company to take over the control of
the railway. The property of this railway in Shanghai,
the Shanghai office of the C.E.R. at No.33 Szechuen
Road and the Yang Ka Doo Wharf (楊家渡碼頭) at Pootung
will be taken over by the International Transportation
Society (國際運輸會社), a Japanese concern, at No.68
Canton Road.

Information has been secured that all
this property was formally handed over to the society
yesterday. The society now has an office at No.33
Szechuen Road.

6469
1935年7月4日。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

中东铁路在上海的财产移交

鉴于向日本出售中东铁路的协定已经缔结，日本政府已授权南满洲铁道株式会社接管该铁路的控制权。该铁路在上海的财产，即位于四川路33号的中东铁路上海办事处以及浦东的杨家渡码头，将由位于广东路68号的日本商号“国际运输会社”（國際運輸會社）接管。

据获悉，上述所有财产已于昨日正式移交给该会社。该会社目前在四川路33号设有办事处。

Subject (in full) Land in Pootung belonging to Chinese Eastern Railway-
Transfer of ownership.
Made by D.S. McKeown.    Forwarded by J. Gould Cpt.

Enquiries have substantiated the report that the Yang
Ka Tu Wharf, the property of the Chinese Eastern Railway, was
formally taken over from the Russian owners by Japanese
interests on July 1. 1935. This property is now owned by
the Manchukuo Government, and Mr Takada , resident representative
of the government has supervised the negotiations for the
purchase. The Japanese International Transport Company,
(Kokusai Nuyu Kaisha), branch office in Foochow Road, will act
as agents for the new owners. The head office of this
company is in Dairen
Information obtained by D.S. Umemoto.

JMcKeown
D. S.
Deputy Commissioner(Special Branch).

Reg.
Copy sent to appropriate authority
Please file.
J.K.
6 JULY 1935.

July 4, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

China Times publishes the following comment:-

THE BRITISH POLITICAL SITUATION

Lloyd George, an old man of seventy,
is making an endeavour to resume his political activities.
His spirit arouses our admiration.
Irrespective of the fact whether or
not the "Council of Action for Peace and Reconstruction"
which was formed by Lloyd George will ever attain its
object, the political situation in Great Britain will
be greatly stimulated by its activities.
The Liberals of Great Britain have
ever held the attitude that Great Britain and the U.S.A.
should unite to deal with Japan in regard to Far Eastern
affairs. The Liberals may or may not be brought into
power by the coming elections but their noisy activities
may push the Conservatives, who now control the country,
into adopting a more effective and progressive policy.

SALE OF UNREGISTERED NEWSPAPERS AND PERIODICALS IN
SETTLEMENT PROHIBITED

According to the provisions of the
Chinese Press Law, all newspapers, periodicals, magazines,
etc. must be registered with the Ministry of Interior
and the Propaganda Department of Central Kuomintang
Headquarters.
Having found that many mosquito papers
in circulation in Shanghai have not complied with this
regulation, the Settlement Authorities have decided that
commencing from the evening of July 3 all papers and
periodicals not registered with the National Government
will not be allowed to be sold within the limits of the
Settlement.

《字林西报》刊登如下评论：

英国政治局势

七十高龄的劳合·乔治正努力恢复其政治活动。他的精神令人钦佩。
无论劳合·乔治组建的“和平与重建行动委员会”能否实现其目标，英国的政治局势都将因其活动而受到极大刺激。
英国自由党人一直持有一种态度，即英国和美国应在远东事务上联合起来对付日本。自由党人可能会也可能不会在即将到来的选举中掌权，但他们喧闹的活动可能会迫使目前控制国家的保守党采取更有效和进步的政策。

中东铁路在上海的财产移交

鉴于向日本出售中东铁路的协定已经缔结，日本政府已授权南满洲铁道株式会社接管该铁路的控制权。该铁路在上海的财产，即位于四川路33号的中东铁路上海办事处以及浦东的杨家渡码头，将由位于广东路68号的日本商号“国际运输会社”（國際運輸會社）接管。
据获悉，上述所有财产已于昨日正式移交给该会社。该会社目前在四川路33号设有办事处。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

禁止在租界内销售未登记的报刊

根据中国出版法规定，所有报纸、期刊、杂志等必须向内政部及国民党中央宣传部登记。
鉴于发现上海流通的许多“蚊子报”未遵守此规定，租界当局决定，自7月3日晚起，凡未在国民政府登记的报刊，一律不得在租界范围内销售。

July 2, 1935.
Afternoon Translation.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 6469
Date 21 7 35

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:-

CHINA AND THE CHINESE-EASTERN RAILWAY

Russia and Japan have concluded an agreement for the sale to Japan of the Chinese-Eastern Railway despite the protests of the Chinese Government which had certain rights in the railway.
Japan has now authorized the South Manchuria Railway Company to take over the control of the Chinese-Eastern Railway including its property in Shanghai, the Yang Ka Doo Wharf (楊家渡碼頭) in Pootung and the Shanghai Office of the Chinese-Eastern Railway at 33 Szechuen Road. Last week the above two organs were secretly transferred to the International Transportation Society (國際運輸会社), a Japanese concern, which represents the South Manchuria Railway Company.
Although Nakano, Manager of the International Transportation Society, denied to a reporter that the property of the Chinese-Eastern Railway in Shanghai had been taken over, it has now been ascertained that the transfer had actually been effected.

Min Pao and other local newspapers:-

NEW CHIEF PROCURATOR OF THE SHANGHAI 2ND SPECIAL DISTRICT COURT

Jao Vai Sien (趙維賢), the newly appointed Chief Procurator of the Shanghai 2nd Special District Court, formally assumed his office at 9 a.m. yesterday.
All documents were handed over to him personally by Chen Pei San (陳佩三) who has been appointed by the Ministry of Justice as Chief Procurator of the Amoy District Court.

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

中国与中东铁路

尽管中国政府对该铁路拥有某些权利并提出抗议，俄国与日本仍就向日本出售中东铁路达成了协议。
日本现已授权南满洲铁道株式会社接管中东铁路的控制权，包括其在上海的财产，即浦东的杨家渡码头和位于四川路33号的中东铁路上海办事处。上周，上述两个机构被秘密移交给代表南满洲铁道株式会社的日本商号“国际运输会社”（國際運輸会社）。
虽然国际运输会社经理中野（Nakano，音译）向记者否认中东铁路在上海的财产已被接管，但现已查明移交实际上已经完成。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

上海第二特区地方法院新任首席检察官

赵维贤，新任上海第二特区地方法院首席检察官，于昨日上午9时正式就职。
所有文件均由陈佩三亲自移交给 him，陈佩三已被司法部任命为厦门地方法院首席检察官。

Date: February 8, 1935.
File: S.N.B.-R.C.L...

Subject (in full) Land in Pootung belonging to Chinese Eastern Railway
- reported negotiations for transfer of ownership

Made by/ and Forwarded by D.I. Grubb

The Chinese Eastern Railway Administration owns
some three mow of land on the east bank of the Whangpoo,
opposite the native Customs house, Nantao, and on this
is located the Yang Ka Tu Wharf. It was purchased about
thirty years ago by the Administration, and for the past
eight years the property has been leased to the Yuan Ih Co.
( 元 一 ), a Chinese concern.

Enquiries at the wharf, as well as offices of the
Companies concerned, have failed to elicit any information
regarding the transfer of the ownership of the land.

The Shanghai office of the Ministry of Foreign
Affairs has no information regarding representations made
by the Soviet Ambassador for the transfer of the ownership
of the land. Mr. Robert Lee, Chief Secretary of the Office,
expressed the opinion that had such representations been
made to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the request for
transfer would have been rejected.

（批：8/2）

H. Grubb.
D. I.

D.C. (Special Branch).

File
M/S 1935
S.I.
Please endeavour to
bring this information up to date
and communicate to us spoken.

主题（全称） 属于中东铁路的浦东土地——据报道正在就所有权转移进行谈判

撰写人/转呈人 D.I. Grubb

中东铁路管理局拥有黄浦江东岸、南市华界海关对面约三亩土地，杨家渡码头即位于此地。该土地由管理局于约三十年前购买，过去八年该财产已出租给中国商号“元一公司”。

对在码头以及相关公司办事处的查询，未能获得任何关于土地所有权转移的信息。

外交部上海办事处没有关于苏联大使为转移土地所有权所作交涉的信息。该办事处首席秘书罗伯特·李（Robert Lee，音译）表示，如果曾向外交部提出此类交涉，转移请求将会被拒绝。

（批注：2/8）

H. Grubb.
督察。

January 30, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers (Nanking telegram):

REQUEST FOR TRANSFER OF LAND BELONGING TO CHINESE
EASTERN RAILWAY REJECTED.

There is a piece of land at Foctung belonging
to the Chinese Eastern Railway Administration.
Following the illegal sale of the railway
by the Soviet Government, the Soviet Ambassador to
China opened negotiations with the Ministry of Foreign
Affairs for the transfer of this land.
As the Chinese Government has not recognized
the illegal sale of the Chinese Eastern Railway,
the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has rejected the
request for the transfer of the land.

（批：SI. Further inquiry on co-operation with Supr. Gen and subsequent plans. M）

1935年1月30日。下午译文。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸（南京电）：

移交中东铁路所属土地的请求被拒。

浦东有一块属于中东铁路管理局的土地。
继苏联政府非法出售该铁路后，苏联驻华大使与外交部就该土地的移交进行了谈判。
由于中国政府未承认中东铁路的非法出售，外交部已拒绝移交土地的请求。

（批注：SI. 进一步查询与总巡的合作及后续计划。M）

April 5, 1935. Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

NIPPO

JAPANESE CONSULS-GENERAL COMING TO SHANGHAI TO
ATTEND CONFERENCE

It is reported that Japanese
Consul-General Kawakoshi of Tientsin and Consul-General
Nishida of Tsinan, and Counsellor Wakasugi, who are
coming to attend the conference of Japanese Consuls-
General to be held in Shanghai, are expected here on
the morning of April 7.

Consul-General Sakane of
Tsingtao and Consul-General Kaai of Canton are due here
on the morning of April 8.

Consul-General Miura of
Hankow left for Shanghai on the S.S. Nanyo Maru on April
4.

All the other Consuls-General
are expected to be in Shanghai before April 8.

WARSHIP " IWATE" TO ACT AS FLAGSHIP OF THIRD FLEET

The flagship "Idzumo" of
the Third Fleet has been ordered to undergo repairs.
Vice-Admiral Hyakutake, Commander-in-Chief of the Third
Fleet left here for Dairen on the cruiser "Kuma" where
he will join in the welcome to the Emperor of Manchukuo.
The Admiral will return to Shanghai on the cruiser "Iwate"
on April 6.

The "Iwate" will act as the
flagship of the Third Fleet untill the repairs of "Idzumo"
have been completed.

MAINICHI

THE KOREAN RESIDENTS ASSOCIATION

It is reported that the Korean
Residents Association is planning to hold a conference
of its important members to devise ways and means to
strengthen the organization and to deal with local Korean
malcontents.

TRANSFER OF THE C.E.R. WHARF AT POOTUNG

The sale of the C.E.R. has
given rise to an international problem. The Chinese
declare that the transfer of the C.E.R. wharf in Shanghai
had been engineered by Japanese militarists for the
purpose of obtaining a wharf for their use. The liquidators
of the Russo-Asiatic Bank have submitted an application
to the Special District Court to seize the wharf but the
Court would not do so.

Fearing that the transfer of
the wharf may give rise to disputes, the Japanese authorities
have prohibited the local Japanese newspapers publishing
reports of the transfer. On April 4 the ban was lifted
by the Japanese authorities because the sale agreement had
been signed, the ownership of the wharf had been clearly
defined and its ownership transferred to Manchukuo.

1935年4月5日。上午译文。

杂项

《日日新闻》

日本总领事来沪参加会议

据悉，前来参加将在上海举行的日本总领事会议的天津总领事川越（Kawakoshi，音译）、济南总领事西田（Nishida，音译）以及参事官若杉（Wakasugi，音译），预计将于4月7日上午抵达此处。

青岛总领事坂根（Sakane，音译）和广州总领事加爱（Kaai，音译）定于4月8日上午抵达此处。

汉口总领事三浦（Miura，音译）于4月4日乘坐“南洋丸”轮前往上海。

其他所有总领事预计将于4月8日前抵达上海。

“岩手”号战舰将担任第三舰队旗舰

第三舰队旗舰“出云”号已奉命进行维修。第三舰队司令长官百武（Hyakutake，音译）海军中将乘坐巡洋舰“球磨”号离开此处前往大连，他将在那里参加欢迎满洲国皇帝的活动。该海军中将将于4月6日乘坐巡洋舰“岩手”号返回上海。

在“出云”号维修完成之前，“岩手”号将担任第三舰队旗舰。

《每日新闻》

朝鲜人居留民团

据悉，朝鲜人居留民团正计划召开重要成员会议，以制定加强组织及应对当地朝鲜不满分子的策略和方法。

浦东中东铁路码头的移交

中东铁路的出售引发了一个国际问题。中方声称，中东铁路上海码头的移交是由日本军国主义者策划的，目的是为其使用获取一个码头。华俄道胜银行的清算人已向特区地方法院申请扣押该码头，但法院未予执行。

出于对码头移交可能引发纠纷的担忧，日本当局禁止当地日本报纸发布有关移交的报道。4月4日，由于买卖协定已签署，码头所有权已明确界定并转移至满洲国，日本当局解除了禁令。

March 24, 1935. Morning translation.
THE SALE OF THE CHINESE EASTERN RAILWAY

After the conclusion of the illegal sale of
the Chinese Eastern ailway between Japan and Soviet
Russia, the local Russo-Asiatic Bank filed on action
in the Shanghai District Court requesting an attachment
order on the C.E.R. Wharf in Shanghai. The Court
instituted an informal inquiry and remanded the case.
It is now learned that the Court has dismissed
the case owing to the fact that the bank had failed
to pay the court fees within the period specified.

D.6469

1935年3月24日。上午译文。
中东铁路的出售

在日本与苏俄之间非法出售中东铁路的协定缔结后，当地华俄道胜银行向上海地方法院提起诉讼，请求对中东铁路上海码头发布查封令。法院进行了非正式调查并将案件延期审理。
现获悉，由于该银行未在规定期限内缴纳诉讼费，法院已驳回此案。

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :
THE SOLICITING OF SUBSCRIPTIONS BY SCHOOLS
There are numerous schools in Shanghai
and many of them are soliciting subscriptions from the
public.
With a view to guarding against mal-practices
in the soliciting of subscriptions by schools, the
Bureau of Education has sent deputies to these schools
to supervise the collection of subscriptions and drawn
up a set of measures governing the soliciting of
subscriptions. The Shanghai City Government has
sanctioned the enforcement of the measures.

Sin Wen Pao (Nanking Telegram) :
THE CHINESE EASTERN RAILWAY PROPERTY IN SHANGHAI
The Chinese Eastern Railway has 18 mow of
land in Footung, Shanghai. The railway has applied
for the registration of the land with the American
Consulate-General.
The Ministry of Railways is opening
negotiations for the restoration of the land to China.

1935年2月15日。下午译文。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：
学校募捐事宜
上海学校众多，其中许多学校正在向公众募集捐款。
为防止学校在募捐过程中出现舞弊行为，教育局已派遣专员前往这些学校监督捐款收集工作，并制定了一套规范募捐行为的措施。上海市政府已批准施行该等措施。

《申报》（南京电）：
中东铁路在上海的财产
中东铁路在上海浦东拥有18亩土地。该铁路已向美国总领事馆申请土地登记。
铁道部正就收回该土地归中国所有一事进行谈判。

February 13, 1935. Afternoon Translation

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers.-

The C.E.R. PROPERTY IN SHANGHAI

According to information from foreign circles, Soviet Russia has already decided to sell the Chinese Eastern Railway. The Soviet Embassy has sent a letter to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs asking that the question of the disposal of Chinese Eastern Railway property in Shanghai be decided upon.
The Ministry has rejected the request on the ground that the illegal sale of the Railway is fundamentally an infringement of the Sino-Russo Agreement.
The Chinese Eastern Railway has an office on Szechuen Road, Shanghai. The house and land estates of this office cost about $200,000. It has also a wharf and go-down at Tootung.
With reference to this illegal sale of the Chinese Eastern Railway, Chu Fu Chuan (朱傅琮), representative of the local Russo-Asiatic Bank Liquidation Committee, recently sent a letter to the Soviet Embassy warning it against the conclusion of the sale. The letter states that the Bank invested 500,000,000 roubles in the Chinese Eastern Railway; the construction expenses of the Railway were all defrayed by the Bank, and that Russia has promised to protect such credit rights.

Ta Mei Wan Pao:-

ASSOCIATION FOR SHOWING RESPECT TO CONFUCIUS

Mr. Fan Kung Chan, Commissioner of Education, and thirty others are promoting original Chinese virtues in order to save the country by the organization of an Association for showing reverence to Confucius.
The District Tangpu has already sanctioned the formation of this organization.
The Preparatory Office of the Association is located at No. 400 A, Route Lafayette. A preparatory meeting will be held at 1 p.m. to-day.

The Shanghai Morning Post, an official organ of General Chiang Kai Shek, published the following article:-

BROADCASTING OF SPEECH RE SINO-JAPANESE QUESTION

The International Intelligence Lecturing Hall of the Shanghai District Education Association has requested Mr. Lee Kung Fu, Chief of the Shun Pao Circular Library, to broadcast a speech on Sino-Japanese relations from 2 p.m. to 3 p.m. February 13 at the An Min (安民) Radio Station.

1935年2月13日。下午译文

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

中东铁路在上海的财产

据外侨界消息，苏俄已决定出售中东铁路。苏联大使馆已向外交部致函，请求就处置上海中东铁路财产一事作出决定。
外交部以非法出售该铁路从根本上侵犯了《中俄协定》为由，拒绝了这一请求。
中东铁路在上海四川路设有一处办事处。该办事处的房屋及地产价值约20万美元。此外，其在浦东还拥有一座码头和仓库。
关于此次非法出售中东铁路一事，本地俄亚银行清算委员会代表朱傅琮（Chu Fu Chuan）近日致函苏联大使馆，警告其不要达成出售协议。信中指出，该银行向中东铁路投资了5亿卢布；铁路的建设费用均由该银行支付，且俄国曾承诺保护此类债权。

《大美晚报》：

尊孔会

教育专员范公展（Fan Kung Chan，音译）先生等三十余人，为弘扬中华传统美德以救国，正发起组织尊孔会。
塘浦区已批准成立该组织。
该会筹备处位于辣斐德路400A号。今日下午1时将举行筹备会议。

作为蒋介石将军官方喉舌的《上海晨报》刊登了以下文章：

关于中日问题的广播演讲

上海区教育协会国际情报演讲厅已邀请《申报》流通图书馆馆长李公甫（Lee Kung Fu，音译）先生，于2月13日下午2时至3时在安民广播电台发表关于中日关系的演讲。
